api_key.hint: 以 ank_ 开头，在 https://animeapi.ai/dashboard/api-keys 创建。新账号免费 3 张，无需绑卡。 Starts with ank_; create one at https://animeapi.ai/dashboard/api-keys.

model.hint: 每张价格：anime $0.003，ultra $0.01，ultra-max $0.02。 Price per image.

orientation.hint: 所有画幅价格相同。 Same price for every shape.

allow_nsfw.description: 允许 NSFW 输出 / Allow NSFW output
allow_nsfw.hint: 默认关闭：被标记的图片会被拒绝并退款，不会发到聊天中。 Off by default: flagged images are refused and refunded.

enhance.description: 自动把提示词改写为标签 / Rewrite prompts into tags
enhance.hint: anime 模型推荐开启。 Recommended for the anime model.

cooldown.description: 每位用户冷却秒数 / Per-user cooldown (seconds)
cooldown.hint: 0 为不限制。 0 disables the limit.

allow_model_override.description: 允许用户用 -m 选择模型 / Let users pick a model with -m
allow_model_override.hint: 默认关闭，避免用户选用更贵的模型。 Off so users cannot choose a more expensive model.

show_prompt.description: 同时发送模型实际收到的标签 / Also send the tags the model received

timeout.description: 等待 AnimeAPI 的秒数 / Timeout (seconds)
